summary: This is a Form 6-K furnished by Maris Tech Ltd., a foreign private issuer, disclosing a Nasdaq notification of non-compliance with the minimum stockholders' equity requirement (Rule 5550(b)(1)). As of Dec 31, 2025, equity was ~$0.6M, below the $2.5M minimum. The company has 45 days (until July 6, 2026) to submit a plan to regain compliance, with a possible 180-day extension. There is no transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. This is a regulatory listing standards notice, not a special situation. The filing has no deal terms; the company's role is solely as the issuer reporting the notification.
